label: b7: fc (100,100), seed 1 of 4 — wave 3 of 4
notes: Batch b7, the fc-layout sweep: 8 layouts x 4 seeds at 50M transitions, two layouts per wave so each wave is a self-contained comparison. Every knob but the network is b3's reference, which is also PPO's default -- lr 3e-4, gamma 0.99, lambda 0.98, entropy 0.01, 128x128 rollout, minibatch 256, 4 epochs -- on b2's reward function, seeds 1-4 pinned so the layouts are seed-matched to each other and to b1/b2/b29/b41/b47. Epochs are 4, not 8: at 8 seeds fc (200,100) scored 12.8% of rows >=98%/500 at 4 epochs (b6) and 7.3% at 8 epochs (b4), while fc 320 at 8 epochs scored 9.6% (b5) -- so the two knobs interact negatively and 4 epochs is the setting the best result to date used. 50M is a quarter of b4/b5/b6's horizon, so a comparison against those three truncates. The cheapest two-layer shape, ~14k parameters -- fewer than fc 500's 17k. If it holds up, the second layer is doing the work rather than the capacity.
